nodes.description: Public uint256 holding the aggregated zNFT value, written only in performUpkeep and constructor.
Public uint32 ERC20 token price in USD used as a multiplier in performUpkeep; writable by anyone.
Public uint32 count of sold NFTs used as the divisor in performUpkeep; writable by anyone, can be set to 0.
Public uint16 target day of month used by checkUpkeep scheduling.
Public uint16 target hour used by checkUpkeep scheduling.
Public uint16 target minute used by checkUpkeep scheduling.
Contract constructor initializing zNFTValue to 0.
External setter for soldNFTCnt with no access control modifier.
External setter for cpERC20TokenPriceUSD with no access control modifier.
External setter for dateDay with bound check and no access control.
External setter for dateHour with bound check and no access control.
External setter for dateMin with bound check and no access control.
Keeper view function comparing parsed block.timestamp date fields against stored dateDay/dateHour/dateMin.
Keeper entry point recomputing zNFTValue with (20000 / soldNFTCnt) * cpERC20TokenPriceUSD.
Internal pure function decomposing a timestamp into a _DateTime struct.
Pure function computing the year from a timestamp with leap-year correction loop.
Pure function returning the number of days for a month/year.
Pure function checking leap year divisibility rules.
Pure function counting leap years before a given year.
Pure function returning the hour component of a timestamp.
Pure function returning the minute component of a timestamp.
Pure function returning the second component of a timestamp.
Pure function returning the weekday index of a timestamp.
Pure function returning the month via parseTimestamp.
Pure function returning the day via parseTimestamp.
Miner/validator-influenced timestamp used for upkeep scheduling in checkUpkeep.
Critical state (price, sold count, schedule) can be overwritten by any external caller because setters lack access control.
(20000 / soldNFTCnt) * cpERC20TokenPriceUSD: division by a user-controlled divisor that can be zero and unchecked value manipulation.

price parameter of setCPERC20TokenPriceUSD.

_min parameter of setDateMin.

edges.reason: block.timestamp is read in checkUpkeep to decide whether upkeep is needed, making scheduling timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp flows into parseTimestamp for decomposition.
getDay delegates to parseTimestamp.
getMonth delegates to parseTimestamp.
parseTimestamp calls getYear for the year component.
parseTimestamp calls getDaysInMonth for month/day accumulation.
parseTimestamp calls getHour.
parseTimestamp calls getMinute.
parseTimestamp calls getSecond.
parseTimestamp calls getWeekday.
getDaysInMonth calls isLeapYear for February resolution.
getYear calls leapYearsBefore twice for leap correction.
getYear calls isLeapYear inside its correction loop.
performUpkeep executes the division and multiplication on user-influenced state values.
soldNFTCnt is the divisor and can be zero or manipulated, causing revert or wrong valuation.
cpERC20TokenPriceUSD is the multiplier and is user-settable.
The arithmetic result is assigned to the zNFTValue state variable.
Anyone can call setSoldNFTCnt and overwrite the divisor state variable.
Anyone can call setCPERC20TokenPriceUSD and overwrite the price state variable.
setSoldNFTCnt performs a privileged state write without any owner or role check.
setCPERC20TokenPriceUSD performs a privileged state write without any owner or role check.
Any external caller can overwrite the upkeep scheduling day.
Any external caller can overwrite the upkeep scheduling hour.
Any external caller can overwrite the upkeep scheduling minute.
Constructor initializes zNFTValue to zero.
checkUpkeep compares parsed day against the mutable dateDay value.
checkUpkeep compares parsed hour against the mutable dateHour value.
checkUpkeep compares parsed minute against the mutable dateMin value.
checkData is echoed back as performData by the keeper simulation.
checkData is the calldata parameter consumed by checkUpkeep.
performData is the calldata parameter passed into performUpkeep.
Unvalidated cnt parameter is written directly into soldNFTCnt.
Unvalidated price parameter is written directly into cpERC20TokenPriceUSD.
_day parameter (bounded to 31) is written into dateDay.
_hour parameter (bounded to 24) is written into dateHour.
_min parameter (bounded to 60) is written into dateMin.
timestamp parameter is the input decomposed by parseTimestamp.
parseTimestamp fills the local _DateTime struct dt.
parseTimestamp accumulates seconds in secondsAccountedFor.
parseTimestamp uses the buf local for leap-year math.
timestamp parameter is used by getYear.
getYear computes and returns the local year variable.
month parameter selects the branch in getDaysInMonth.
year parameter is forwarded to isLeapYear in getDaysInMonth.
year parameter is tested by isLeapYear.
timestamp parameter is reduced by getHour.

normalization_plan.reason: cnt parameter exists only to write soldNFTCnt in setSoldNFTCnt.
price parameter exists only to write cpERC20TokenPriceUSD in setCPERC20TokenPriceUSD.
_day parameter exists only to write dateDay in setDateDay.
_hour parameter exists only to write dateHour in setDateHour.
_min parameter exists only to write dateMin in setDateMin.
checkData is the calldata consumed and echoed by checkUpkeep.
performData is the calldata parameter of performUpkeep.
timestamp is the sole input decomposed by parseTimestamp.
dt is the local result struct constructed inside parseTimestamp.
secondsAccountedFor is a scratch accumulator used only in parseTimestamp.
buf is a scratch leap-year buffer used only in parseTimestamp.
timestamp is the sole input of getYear.
year is the local result computed and returned by getYear.
month is the branch selector parameter of getDaysInMonth.
year is the leap-year parameter of getDaysInMonth.
year is the sole input of isLeapYear.
timestamp is the sole input of getHour.
